title: r2 minor QE: flake aggregation leaves a stable neither-kind outcome unclassified
description: Evidence: gate-data.md:24 — aggregation defines red (fails all), green (passes all), flaky (mixed); a pin skipped/ignored/filtered/not-collected in ALL runs is none of the three. Disposition: consistent neither-kind outcomes aggregate to the recorded neither state; flaky reserved for genuinely mixed. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: quality-engineer.
